description: This file defines a Sequelize model for the 'Role' entity, representing system roles such as 'superadmin', 'manager', etc. It specifies the schema, including fields like 'id', 'name', 'description', and 'isSystem', along with associations to the User model.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: A Sequelize model representing a system role with properties such as id, name, description, and isSystem, along with associations to users.

methods.name: associate
methods.description: Defines many-to-many relationship between Role and User models through UserRole junction table.
